description: This file defines the CartViewModel class for managing shopping cart data and logic in an Android application, along with the UI model CartRow for representing sections in a RecyclerView.

classes.name: CartViewModel
classes.description: ViewModel for cart UI, managing cart items, grouping, and summary data.

classes.name: CartRow
classes.description: Sealed class representing UI rows for categories and items in a RecyclerView.

methods.name: addItem
methods.description: Adds a specified quantity of a product to the cart.

methods.name: removeItem
methods.description: Removes a product from the cart by its ID.

methods.name: updateQty
methods.description: Updates the quantity of a product in the cart.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all items from the cart.
